caption:
Everyone in growth makes confident calls. Almost no one checks them.

Growth Terminal logs every forecast and tracks it against your real revenue, verified or missed. You build trust in the calls that keep landing and catch the ones that don't. Accountability is the feature.

Diagnose your #1 constraint free. Link in bio.
first_comment: When we're wrong, the tool says so. That's the point.
alt_text: The forecast, checked against real revenue.
